title: "03 — temporal dynamics: rainfall response, core, and viability"

  html:

---

Figure 3 asks whether the Empty Quarter microbiome responds to the
stochastic pulse of rainfall, and whether the temporally stable "core"
signal we see is driven by viable cells or by accumulated relic DNA.

* **A.** Distributed-lag rainfall-response model: Spearman ρ between
  Shannon diversity / responder-phylum abundance and cumulative rainfall
  over 1–30 day antecedent windows, per compartment.
* **B.** Core vs. transient genera across trips (stacked relative
  abundance).
* **C.** PMA viability overlay: surface responder genera vs. Active
  Resident genera in the PMA Trip-5 subset (Jaccard + volcano).

```{python}
#| label: setup
import sys
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path.cwd().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO / "src"))

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from eq import CACHE_DIR, FIGURES_DIR, DATA_DIR
from eq.climate import add_rainfall_to_metadata
from eq.diversity import aggregate_to_rank, relative_abundance, shannon

plt.rcParams.update({
    "figure.dpi": 120, "font.size": 9,
    "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False,
})
```

## Load tables + build antecedent rainfall windows

```{python}
#| label: load
ft = pd.read_parquet(CACHE_DIR / "feature_table.parquet")
tax = pd.read_parquet(CACHE_DIR / "taxonomy.parquet")
meta = pd.read_parquet(CACHE_DIR / "metadata.parquet")
meta = meta.dropna(subset=["trip", "compartment"]).copy()
meta["trip"] = meta["trip"].astype(int)
meta["site"] = meta["site"].astype(int)
ft = ft[meta.index]
print(f"{ft.shape[0]:,} ASVs × {ft.shape[1]:,} samples")

meta_rw = add_rainfall_to_metadata()
meta_rw = meta_rw.set_index("sample").loc[meta.index]
meta = meta.join(meta_rw.drop(columns=[c for c in meta_rw.columns if c in meta.columns]))
meta["shannon"] = shannon(ft)
meta.head(3)
```

## A. Distributed-lag rainfall response

```{python}
#| label: fig3a-dlm
from scipy.stats import spearmanr

windows = [1, 3, 7, 10, 14, 30]
phy = aggregate_to_rank(ft, tax, rank="phylum")
phy_rel = relative_abundance(phy)
meta["responder_frac"] = (
    phy_rel.reindex(["Bacteroidota", "Pseudomonadota"]).fillna(0).sum(axis=0)
)

rows = []
for comp in ("surface", "deep", "rhizosphere"):
    m = meta[meta["compartment"] == comp]
    for w in windows:
        col = f"rain_W{w}d"
        if col not in m.columns: continue
        x = m[col]; y_s = m["shannon"]; y_r = m["responder_frac"]
        ok = x.notna() & y_s.notna()
        r_s, p_s = spearmanr(x[ok], y_s[ok])
        r_r, p_r = spearmanr(x[ok], y_r[ok])
        rows.append({"compartment": comp, "window_d": w,
                     "shannon_rho": r_s, "shannon_p": p_s,
                     "responder_rho": r_r, "responder_p": p_r,
                     "n": ok.sum()})
dlm = pd.DataFrame(rows)
dlm.to_csv(CACHE_DIR / "rainfall_lag_response.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)
dlm
```

```{python}
#| label: fig3a-plot
palette = {"surface": "#d62728", "deep": "#1f77b4", "rhizosphere": "#2ca02c"}
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4), sharex=True)
for comp, grp in dlm.groupby("compartment"):
    ax1.plot(grp["window_d"], grp["shannon_rho"], "-o", label=comp,
             color=palette[comp])
    ax2.plot(grp["window_d"], grp["responder_rho"], "-o", label=comp,
             color=palette[comp])
for ax, ylab in zip((ax1, ax2),
                     ("Shannon vs rain (ρ)", "Bacteroidota+Pseudomonadota vs rain (ρ)")):
    ax.axhline(0, color="grey", lw=0.5)
    ax.set_xlabel("antecedent window (days)")
    ax.set_ylabel(ylab)
    ax.set_xscale("log")
    ax.set_xticks(windows); ax.set_xticklabels(windows)
ax1.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(FIGURES_DIR / "fig3a_rainfall_lag.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
```

## B. Core / opportunist / conditionally-rare / transient

The manuscript's original rule — "present in ≥4 of 5 trips with any
non-zero read" — conflates detection with persistence: any abundant
genus is trivially "present" everywhere, inflating the core fraction to
~99 % and shrinking the transient pool to ~0.3 %. That's a tautology,
not ecology.

We replace it with the Shade & Handelsman (2012, *Environ Microbiol*) /
Dini-Andreote et al. (2015, *ISME J*) prevalence-abundance framework:
presence requires relative abundance ≥ 0.1 % in a sample, per-trip
prevalence ≥ 50 % for core membership, and a ``conditionally rare``
category captures genera that bloom to ≥ 1 % occasionally but are
globally rare (< 20 % prevalence).

```{python}
#| label: fig3b-core
from eq.core_transient import classify_genera
gen = aggregate_to_rank(ft, tax, rank="genus")
gen = gen[~gen.index.isin(["unclassified", "NA", ""])]

cat = classify_genera(gen, meta)
print("Genera per category (new framework):")
print(cat["category"].value_counts())
print()

# Abundance share per category (mean across samples × compartment × trip)
gen_rel = relative_abundance(gen)
gen_rel["category"] = cat["category"]
by_cat = gen_rel.groupby("category").sum().drop(columns=[], errors="ignore")
# Per-sample category shares
cat_share = by_cat.T  # samples × categories
cat_share = cat_share.join(meta[["trip", "compartment"]])

# Aggregate to (trip, compartment) means
agg = (cat_share.groupby(["trip", "compartment"])
       [list(by_cat.index)].mean()).sort_index()
print("Mean abundance share per (trip, compartment):")
print(agg.round(3))
```

```{python}
#| label: fig3b-plot
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4))
cat_order = ["core", "opportunist", "conditionally_rare", "rare_transient", "other"]
cat_palette = {
    "core": "#2ca02c", "opportunist": "#ff7f0e",
    "conditionally_rare": "#9467bd", "rare_transient": "#7f7f7f",
    "other": "#d3d3d3",
}
agg[cat_order].plot.bar(
    stacked=True, ax=ax,
    color=[cat_palette[c] for c in cat_order],
    edgecolor="white", linewidth=0.3,
)
ax.set_ylabel("relative abundance")
ax.set_xlabel("")
ax.set_xticklabels([f"T{t}-{c[:3]}" for (t, c) in agg.index], rotation=60, ha="right")
ax.legend(title="category", frameon=False, bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1),
          loc="upper left", fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(FIGURES_DIR / "fig3b_core_transient.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
```

## C. PMA viability overlay

```{python}
#| label: fig3c-pma
pma_path = DATA_DIR / "../../code-and-data/data/processed/relic_dna/c2s.tsv"
if pma_path.exists():
    pma = pd.read_csv(pma_path, sep="\t")
    # Clean column names
    pma.columns = [c.strip() for c in pma.columns]
    print("PMA columns:", list(pma.columns[:12]))
    print(f"  rows: {len(pma)}")
    # Classification counts
    if "Viability Status" in pma.columns:
        print()
        print(pma["Viability Status"].value_counts())
else:
    print(f"PMA data not found at {pma_path}")
```
